docs.title: Manexp-Web-Lists
docs.text:
This repository aggregates and transforms data originating from multiple third-party sources, including public institutions and open data platforms for Manexp-Web project.

Github repository: https://github.com/edouardbruelhart/Manexp-Web-Lists/

Documentation https://edouardbruelhart.github.io/Manexp-Web-Lists/

docs.title: Available lists:
docs.text:
Cleaned, resolved, translated, iconed and colored taxon list with related commercial crops denomination and information

Source documentation: https://food.ec.europa.eu/plants/plant-reproductive-material/plant-variety-catalogues-databases-information-systems_en

Source dataset: https://ec.europa.eu/food/plant-variety-portal/index.xhtml

Cleaned phytosanitary products list

Source documentation: https://www.blv.admin.ch/fr/index-des-produits-phytosanitaires

Source dataset: https://www.blv.admin.ch/dam/fr/sd-web/He9bAfs8CmFT/daten-pflanzenschutzmittelverzeichnis-fr.zip

docs.title: Contributing
docs.text: Contributions are welcome, and they are greatly appreciated!

docs.title: Data sources
docs.text: This project depends on external datasets from third-party sources, including public institutions and open data platforms. All sources, attribution details, and transformation notes are documented in DATA_SOURCES.md.
